svg.desc: Reference reconstruction of user-supplied IMG_8173.PNG panel 10. Live editable text and native vector geometry. Original typefaces unidentified; Inter 400/900 used as licensed substitutes. Photographs are cropped only from their regions in the supplied image. Unreadable miniature placeholder prose is an approximation of its density, not a verified transcription.
